limitations: Assumes exactly K distinct components with known equal weights and exact anchor locations. This is an exact, not noise-robust, result; close support points can make numerical root recovery ill-conditioned. Equivalent formulations may exist in classical finite-moment or equal-weight quadrature literature.
provenance: A sharp identifiability theorem for equal-weight finite binomial mixtures, motivated by the classical binomial-mixture threshold and the sparse Hausdorff moment problem.
record_title: Exact identifiability threshold for equal-weight binomial mixtures with known anchors
